name: anophthalmia/microphthalmia-esophageal atresia syndrome
description: Anophthalmia-esophageal atresia syndrome belongs to the group of syndromic microphthalmias and is characterized by the association of uni- or bilateral anophthalmia or microphthalmia, and esophageal atresia with or without trachoesophageal fistula.
